name: LaDataViz
description: Add-on tools for Tableau: Figma to Tableau ($15/mo), Viz Extensions ($20/mo), LaDataViz Pro ($30/mo), and custom Enterprise. Target persona: Tableau users building and managing dashboards. Founded Jul 2023, Spain. TrustMRR lists ~3,000 estimated users (founder-stated).

mentions.evidence: ~$3,350 MRR (−5.5% L30), 140 active subscriptions, ~$3,074 L30, ~$153,734 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 7, 2026 ~06:13 Warsaw (04:13 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Same play for any expensive enterprise tool with a plugin API and a professional user base: Power BI custom visuals, Looker Studio connectors, SAP Analytics Cloud widgets, Excel add-ins for accountants. Small monthly fee, sold in the community where those people already hang out.

whyItPrints: Enterprise BI tool, expensive seats, and designers/analysts who'll expense $20/mo without asking. Tableau's own extension ecosystem is thin, so a specialist with a few sharp tools owns the niche. 140 subs at ~$24 average (my calculation) on only ~645 visitors in L30.
